messages:
sara (eng-platform): thinking about adding an opt-in telemetry surface from client SDKs to improve quota burn visibility in the Console. goal: let customers see near-realtime per-tenant and per-route token burn (sampled) without leaking PII. rough proposal below.

tom (devex): sounds useful. main concerns: privacy/PII, storage/cost, and making API ergonomic across py/ts/go. :thinking: keep it opt-in by default?

devon (eng-platform): agree opt-out by default. also want a single small footprint API so we don't bloat SDKs.

kevin (console): console needs: 1) aggregated burn per-tenant (1m rollup), 2) per-route delta charts (sampled), 3) flag to hide tenant-level data if customer opts out for compliance. also need clear consent wording.

sara (eng-platform): proposed telemetry payload (opt-in only):
```
# header
X-RW-Telemetry-OptIn: quota_burn=1

# JSON body (sampled)
{
  "tenant_hash": "sha256(<tenant-id-salt>)",
  "route": "text.generate",
  "tokens": 42,
  "model": "redwood/open-1.0",
  "sample_rate": 0.05
}
```
- tenant_hash: salted/hashed tenant id (no raw tenant ids).
- sample_rate: client-side sampling rate (0 < r <= 1). SDK should never send >100 reqs/s per tenant for telemetry.

mike (eng-sre): we must enforce server-side throttles and reject oversized payloads. also require max ingestion QPS per API key and a fallback to aggregated-only if limits hit.

devon (eng-platform): SDK surface proposal:
- Python/TS: add Telemetry.opt_in(sample_rate=0.01) + Telemetry.opt_out()
- Go: env var + small helper func due to typical embedding patterns
- default: disabled, opt-in required in code or env var
- telemetry calls should be non-blocking and fire-and-forget with a bounded queue (drop if full)

tom (devex): docs + migration plan notes: include snippet in quickstart, add a migration guide for customers who want to opt in, and update privacy page with retention and hashing details. release note will need to call out opt-in behavior and sampling defaults.

sara (eng-platform): rollout plan idea:
- week 0: RFC + spec in docs repo
- week 1: Py SDK PR (opt-in flag) + small canary to internal tenants
- week 2: TS SDK parity + demo app
- week 3: Go helper + enable console ingestion pipeline (ingest-only when header present)
- week 4: cross-check legal/PM wording + public docs and sample dashboard

kevin (console): add a dashboard mock (mock data shape plz) and UX copy for consent. retention: default 90 days for sampled telemetry, 365 days only for aggregated monthly billing rolls. also add a toggle to disable per-tenant breakdowns in org settings.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2025-02-11T15:00:00Z - 2025-02-11T18:00:00Z (canary team: devex + eng-platform).

sara (eng-platform): SGTM. I'll open the RFC and a Py SDK draft PR today. @tom can you own the docs snippet? @kevin please attach the mock dashboard here when ready. tagging @mike for SRE limits check.

tom (devex): will do. i'll draft quickstart + API docs and a short migration checklist.

mike (eng-sre): i'll propose throttling params in the RFC (max 2000 telemetry events/s total, per-tenant soft cap 50/s) and a server-side sampling override if ingestion pressure is high.

devon (eng-platform): one more impl note: keep telemetry queue bounded at SDK side to avoid blocking callers; prefer background worker with exponential backoff on 5xx.

sara (eng-platform): perfect. thanks everyone — PRs/links in this thread pls.
